Check that every type file of this directory was generated from the project as it is now, by the
version each file carries in its header. Exits with 1 when a file is stale, missing or carries no
version, so a build can stop before shipping slugs that no longer exist.

The files are listed under "types" in voidhash.json, each with its "language" (typescript, swift or
kotlin) and "output" path. Without any, one TypeScript declaration file is written to
voidhash.gen.d.ts.

A TypeScript file types the Voidhash SDKs the package.json in this directory depends on,
@voidhash/react-native and @voidhash/web, or @voidhash/react-native without either. It also lists
the project's feature flag keys, leaving archived flags out, and the text values of their variants;
a flag or variant added since the file was written is not in it.

Usage:
  voidhash types check [flags]

Flags:
  -h, --help           Show help for this command
      --language <typescript|swift|kotlin>
                       Only the files of this language
      --output <path>  Use this path instead of the configured one; needs --language when several
                       files are configured

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash types check
  voidhash types check --language kotlin
